text:
marie: Quick sync — GA checklist for the upcoming inference release. I want a single-owner list for SLA, docs, monitoring, support playbooks, and pricing triggers. Who's got what?
kevin: I can own SLA and rollback/escape-hatch doc. Need to clarify SLO numbers (p50/p95/p99) we commit to for Hosted vs Dedicated.
josh: I'll take monitoring + alerting. We should ship an SLI dashboard + two runbooks (latency spike, token-quotas).
lisa: Docs owner here — will stage the public GA docs under /docs/ga/inference and the internal runbooks under Confluence. Need final wording on observable fields.
marie: Good. Two quick constraints: legal wants a max 30-day log retention opt-in for Private customers; finops needs a pricing floor for burst buckets to avoid negative unit economics.
kevin: For SLOs proposal: Hosted: p95 <= 220ms for short prompts, p99 <= 850ms with fallback policy. Dedicated: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms. Is that aggressive? :thinking_face:
josh: Those look reasonable but we need to quantify variance on long-context workloads. I'll add a heatmap of sequences >4096 tokens. Also propose an alert: "persistent_p99_increase_10pct_15m" -> pager.
marie: Sounds good. @kevin add explicit fallback chain (model-variant -> region-failover -> degraded-mode) in the SLA doc.
kevin: On it. I'll include a table with acceptable degradations and customer-visible messaging for each step.
lisa: Request: can someone paste the final field names we want in telemetry? I need them for the docs and sample troubleshooting snippet.
josh: Minimal set: model_name, model_variant, seq_len, tokens_generated, latency_ms, shard_id, region, customer_tier. Also add cache_hit boolean.
marie: Nice. Lisa, use those. Also include a short curl example for customers to run smoke checks.
lisa: Copy. Draft sample block: ```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate | jq .
```
kevin: For support playbooks: I suggest three levels — L1 triage (console + logs), L2 (model fallback & routing checks), L3 (capacity & kernel-level issues). I'll map oncall rotation.
sam: On pricing: prod needs a burst-surcharge rule when Dedicated pool utilization > 85% for 5m. Finops wants the surcharge to be configurable per-customer with a minimum delta of 20% over base request cost. I'll prepare an example calc.
marie: Good. Also create a promo/early-adopter discount rule we can toggle at launch. Sam, can you document that with API examples?
sam: Yep. Will add examples and a CLI to preview cost impact.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: smoke-run completed on staging at 1778312700 — 0.6% p99 regressions vs baseline, no infra errors. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Nice. Two blockers I foresee: (1) legal on retention + (2) SRE must sign off on region-failover test plan.
josh: I'll schedule the region failover test for Wed 09:00 PT and invite SRE. Will include test checklist: drain -> reroute -> validate latencies -> rollback.
lisa: Docs staging link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFER/GA+Docs+Staging (internal) — ping me if you want editorial review.
marie: Action items: Kevin -> SLA + escape-hatches (due EOD Fri), Josh -> monitoring dashboards + failover test plan (due Tue), Lisa -> public GA docs draft + troubleshooting snippets (due Thu), Sam -> pricing examples + promo toggle API (due Thu). Everyone confirm.
kevin: Confirmed.
josh: Confirmed.
lisa: Confirmed.
sam: Confirmed.
marie: If no objections by EOD today we'll lock these owners and send a one-pager to PM/Legal/FinOps. :rocket:
